changelog:
## What's New in v1.5.3

### 🖼️ Fiverr-Style Crisp Borders Everywhere
- Added solid, crisp 1.5dp borders to all status cards (Module Enabled, WhatsApp, Business, Update Available)
- Added crisp 1dp outline borders (`#CBD5E1`) to all Info Cards, Diagnostics Cards, and Backup Cards
- Reduced card corner radius to 12dp/16dp for a tight, modern aesthetic

### 🌊 Fluid Pill Navigation Bar
- Upgraded bottom navigation bar to a Fluid Pill format (64dp wide x 36dp high smooth rounded indicator)
- Elevated bottom navigation container with smooth 70dp layout density
